notes: Neater layout on every screen size: aligned top strips, evenly sized opening-hours rows
Opening hours now colour-coded: green open, amber lunch, red closed, with today highlighted
Daily study reminder: add a repeating reminder to your phone calendar at a time you choose
Settings button made smaller to match the new top icons; top icons now scroll with the page
Before you go: a friendly reminder of today's goal when pressing Back, and a welcome back message when you return
Call button now shows our opening hours and a friendly note first, with Call now, WhatsApp and Book options
Tidier footer: equal-size link buttons with icons, in three groups
Book, Call and Directions are now small icons at the very top, beside the settings button
Simpler app: a shorter top bar with Book and Call first, a More tools button, a More tab for less-used sections, and grouped footer links
Richer liquid-glass look: a soft drifting colour glow behind frosted cards, brighter glass edges and a frosted top bar
Booking and directions buttons moved to the front of the top bar; the header now shows the total number of questions
Back up my progress: save your streak and results to a file and restore them on any phone. Challenge links now warn if the app is old
Updated privacy and terms for appointments, calls and directions; better search and link previews
Get directions button (Google Maps) in the top bar, footer and booking confirmation
Book an appointment: pick a service, day and time within our opening hours and send the request on WhatsApp
Call us and WhatsApp us buttons
App tour for new users, and press-and-hold any button to see what it does
Play with friends: challenge a friend by WhatsApp link, or party quiz on one phone, and ask a friend any question
Trending bar on Today: tough and important questions, new picks every day
Study Lab, quick tools, animated logo opening, liquid-glass look and J&K Special questions
Animated logo when the app opens
New Study Lab tab: mistake notebook, speed round, negative-marking trainer, flashcards, explain-it-back, last-7-days plan, weak-topic radar, badges, result card
New quick tools at the top: streak, daily goal, next deadline, search, saved, calculator, focus timer with rain sound, news, dark mode
New liquid-glass look: frosted cards, glossy buttons that press in, ripple, and a soft glow and buzz on correct answers
Greeting card background now follows your local weather (optional, pick your town). Also: J&K Special questions, deadline list and a literary look
Weather in the greeting card: optional, pick your town, animated sun, clouds, rain and snow, with a study tip
Cleaner deadline helper: colour-coded bullets and a friendlier empty state
About 970 new J&K Special questions for JKSSB and JKPSC: history, geography, polity, culture, economy and more, plus statement-based advanced ones
My exam deadlines (Today tab): add an exam and its last date, see a live countdown, and get colour-coded guidance (green, amber, red) so you apply before websites get slow
Answer analysis under every question, plus new Advanced statement-based questions
